lines.text:
ERIKA: Oh, if it isn’t the one who’s been trying
to fill the Pokédex.\c
I do hope things have been going well for you
since our last encounter.\c
...I see.
You certainly have been busy.
I’m not particularly fond of those kinds of
public things...\c
However, battles are different.
That’s what you came for, isn’t it?

ERIKA: ...Zzz...zzz...\c
Oh, good day to you.\c
...Hm? A battle? Right now?
But of course. I graciously accept.
ERIKA: Simply marvelous.\c\nThat was an effort worthy at least 10\nRainbow Badges.
